title: Slip-On Knit Casual Sneakers with Continuous Sock Cuff and Rear Pull Loop for Footwear Collections
highlights:
Continuous sock cuff: The knitted upper rises around the ankle into a plain pull-on opening, without lace or strap fastenings.

Simple daily dressing: The slip-on opening removes the need to tie conventional laces when putting the shoes on.

A grip for entry: The pull loop provides a place to hold the shoe while guiding the foot into the opening.
